verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships an official CLI (clickhousectl) that installs/manages local versions, launches/manages local servers, executes queries, sets up cloud clusters, and pushes local dev to cloud, plus clickhouse-local for keyless SQL inspection, confirmed by hands-on runtime probes showing a real keyless install and SQL roundtrip. This covers create, connect, shell, and inspect without a dashboard. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on review of clickhousectl itself (only clickhouse-local/install were runtime-verified) and more detail on 'inspect databases' UX (e.g. schema browsing) beyond query execution.
